findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 21 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 21 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "ACT I // DUAL SANCTUARY" above "STRENGTH MEETS Glamour."; "ACT II // KINETIC MANIFESTO" above "MOMENTUM IS Engineered."; "REEL 02 // 000%" (pill) above "CLOSE TRACKING THROUGH A SHAFT OF DAYLIG"; "ACT III // CURATED DISCIPLINES" above "STRENGTH MEETS Salon Sanctuary."; "SPEC #1 // KHARDAHA ATELIER" (pill) above "UNISEX STRENGTH & Calibrated Iron."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "DRAG 360° TO INSPECT · 301°", "REEL 01", "·", "00:01:30"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01 / 03", "01", "02", "03", "04", "02"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 170 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "DRAG 360° TO INSPECT · 301°", "REEL 01", "ACT I // DUAL SANCTUARY", "SPEC // 01 · INFRARED & CHAMPAGNE GOLD").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ★ ✕
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.
